blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Residents across Bohol province are being urged to wear face masks as haze continues to blanket large parts of the province. Some residents noticed the smoke appearing thicker on Saturday than in previous days. Bohol Gov. Erico Aristotle Aumentado advised the public to take precautions and limit prolonged outdoor exposure unless necessary. READ: Bohol folk urged to take precautions as haze blankets parts of province Aumentado said those who need to go outside should wear an N95 or equivalent mask for added protection, particularly children, senior citizens, and people with heart or respiratory conditions.
